faq.headline: Questions and answers.
faq.subtext: Everything worth knowing before buying. Full list lives on the FAQ page.

items.a: DriveX Gaming (DriveX Store) is a trusted MLBB and game accounts marketplace trusted by over 102K+ gamers. Every account goes through strict ownership verification and clean bind checks before being listed.

items.q: How often are new MLBB accounts listed?
items.a: We list fresh, verified MLBB accounts daily -- ranging from budget-friendly starter accounts to high-tier Collector, Legend, and rare event skin accounts.

items.q: How is DriveX Gaming different from random social media sellers?
items.a: Unlike unverified peer-to-peer trades, DriveX Gaming inspects every account's bind history, guarantees clean third-party unbinding, handles step-by-step Moonton email transfers, and backs verified accounts with a lifetime warranty.

items.q: How long does the account handover take?
items.a: Handover is fast and usually completed within 5 to 15 minutes after payment confirmation. Our support team stays with you until the Moonton email and password are fully changed to yours.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept KBZPay, WavePay, Thai Bank Transfer (PromptPay), and international card payments via Stripe.

items.q: Are all third-party binds removed before delivery?
items.a: Yes. Every account is checked to ensure clean binds (no lingering Facebook, TikTok, VK, or Game Center connections) so you receive 100% full ownership.

items.q: Do you offer budget or starter MLBB accounts?
items.a: Yes. Alongside Collector and Legend tier accounts, we regularly drop verified starter and mid-tier accounts at affordable prices.

items.q: How does the Lifetime Warranty work?
items.a: Our Lifetime Warranty protects buyers against account retrieval by the original owner. Keep your transaction receipt and follow our security checklist after handover to remain fully protected.

items.q: Can I sell or trade in my MLBB account to DriveX Gaming?
items.a: Yes. We buy and trade verified MLBB accounts. Message our support team with your skin list, rank, and bind details for a quick quote.

items.q: Do VIP members get discounts on account bundles?
items.a: Yes. Active DriveX VIP members receive exclusive discounts and early access to newly listed Collector and Legend accounts.

items.q: What is DriveX Gaming's refund policy?
items.a: If an account does not match the listed skins, rank, or clean bind status prior to handover completion, you receive a 100% full refund or instant replacement.
